faq.q1: What can I do with credits?
faq.a1: Each credit allows you to generate one complete app. You can use credits to create web apps, mobile apps, landing pages, and more using our AI-powered builder.
faq.a2: No! Your purchased credits never expire. Use them whenever you want, at your own pace.
faq.a3: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for unused credits. Contact our support team for assistance.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and PayPal.
faq.q5: How does the free tier work?
faq.a5: Every new user gets 2 free generations to try AppNode. No credit card required to get started!
